method: Equal-weight seed means; sample SD (ddof=1); two-sided 95% Student-t CI across seeds.
spectral_scope: One unique 784x784 hidden matrix passes min(shape)>=64. The confidence/tail average equals that single ordinary fitted alpha. Input/readout are excluded a priori; layer dispersion is undefined. This is not a collective many-layer marginality test.
endpoint_policy: 2,000 and 20,000 updates are fixed budgets. primary_best_validation uses the minimum validation RMSE before the first 16-bad-epoch stop. Later training cannot replace that primary checkpoint. Test outcomes never select a model.

paper.title: Benchmarking Optimizers for MLPs in Tabular Deep Learning
paper.uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over 10 independent model seeds on a fixed dataset split

native_replication_minus_published_adamw.method: independent-seed Welch Student-t interval; not paired; not an equivalence test

published_comparison.interpretation: Published results use validation stopping and different training seeds/runtime. The current native AdamW recipe matches the published architecture and settings; CPU results need not be numerically identical to the authors' GPU results. Published SGD and Muon-EMA use separately tuned architectures, so they are context, not same-model optimizer controls. Fixed-update results must not be compared as if they used the paper's checkpoint selection. A confidence interval containing zero does not establish equivalence or reproduction within a prespecified tolerance.
